text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
December. Walking through the city after 
an off-campus interview, an idea suddenly 
struck me.
choice_data_list:
Would you like to celebrate Christmas 
together, if you'd like?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: My! A celebration?
choice_data_list:
Yeah. As a reward for working hard these 
three years.

Yeah. As a reward for three years of hard 
work.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. My soul's resonating partner is 
truly devoted, isn't he? The Saintess is 
pleased.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
“Yet, I feel the exact same way. You are 
someone who deserves to be cared for as 
well.”

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
That is why—let us exchange gifts. Our 
feelings for one another, and our 
blessings.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Do that, and this holy day shall become 
more wonderful than anything else.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: (Besides—this is a good opportunity.)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(Listen, Trainer. I might not look it, 
but... I am a little upset, you know?)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(That day when you brought up transferring 
overseas. I know that for a split second, 
you were willing to let me go.)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(It is not merely out of reverence. 
...Deep down in your heart, I am certain 
you still doubt yourself somewhere.)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(And to think they possess such a 
magnificent soul.)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
That is why— I shall bestow a great 
blessing upon you.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
So that you will no longer doubt yourself. 
So that you can stand by my side, freely 
and proudly, from now on.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: That I, Saint Red Desire, would...!

text_block_list.name: Dorm Resident
text_block_list.text:
Ack, this shower is freezing!? 
Desire-chan, what are you doing!?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(C-Clear your mind and even cold water 
feels warm. Clear your mind and even cold 
water feels warm...!)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(It's cold... It hurts... But I can feel 
it. My body is being purified, and my 
Saintly Power is rising!)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(It is all to bestow a grand blessing. A 
trial of this magnitude is...)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I-I-I-I'll ov-overgome thiz, juuuuzt watch 
me...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Ah, Desire-chan! Good morning~.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh? That's rare for you. Eating 
something other than the Carrot Hamburg 
Steak Set.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I am currently enduring a great 
trial. The trial of refraining from my 
absolute favorite food...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Ah! S-Sorry! It must be painful having 
it right in front of you when you're 
trying to hold back. I-I'll move to 
another seat...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Wait... Actually, I want them to be right 
in front of me. It's precisely through 
harsh trials... that the blessings upon 
overcoming them—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...Guh!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
That takes care of the power stone. Now 
then—let us perform the purification 
ritual.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Washed with sacred mountain spring 
water...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Expose it to the moonlight...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Bathe me... in the first light... of 
morning...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Ha!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(Now, I just thread them on the string 
while pouring my prayers into each one...)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
May blessings be bestowed upon that 
person...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then came Christmas Day.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
So this is... the line-worthy carrot 
hamburg steak! It truly does melt right in 
your mouth...!
choice_data_list: Haha, it was worth bringing you here!
Hehe, it was worth bringing you along.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you once again for such wonderful 
congratulations. The dress, the dinner... 
It all makes me truly happy."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
It feels just like being inside an isekai 
novel...♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her beaming smile, I breathed a 
sigh of relief. The "One-Day Isekai Gift" 
was apparently a huge success.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: "My, my! Who might this cutie be...!?"
choice_data_list:
Like friends you made during the overseas 
campaign or something

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As overseas expeditions increase, there 
will surely be more days spent in 
loneliness.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I prepared this with the wish that it 
would support her during times like that.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. ...I have received your wish loud 
and clear.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...Well then, it's about time for my turn, 
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: —O resonator of my soul, come this way.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Led along, we returned to the hill. Red 
Desire, having changed into her racing 
silks before I knew it, spoke in a solemn 
voice that echoed out.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Take my hand.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Holding out my right hand as told, 
something cold is swiftly wrapped around 
my wrist.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, it wasn't just any bracelet; 
it appeared to be made of power stones.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...By the blessing of the Sunstone, may 
you learn to love yourself from the bottom 
of your heart.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
By the blessing of the smoky quartz, may 
the ground beneath your feet remain 
unshakable.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"By the blessing of labradorite, may thy 
soul become the eye that pierces through 
to the truth."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
By the protection of the moonstone, may 
your doubts vanish and the guiding star 
reveal your path.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Through the blessing of tanzanite, may you 
choose your destiny with pride.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: —Saintess Red Desire offers her prayers.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
By the blessing of the five stones, may an 
unyielding core dwell within your soul, 
allowing you to walk your chosen path with 
pride.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My heart burns hot. Her wishes and 
blessings feel as though they're setting 
my soul ablaze in crimson.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Please, remember this once more.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: My future lies with you.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
No matter what kind of world I enter, that 
is the one unchanging truth.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"And then... um, Trainer. Do you still 
have room in your stomach?"
choice_data_list: My stomach? Ah, I'm fine, though.
My stomach? Yeah, I'm fine, though.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Um, to tell you the truth, I had prepared 
a homemade Christmas cake.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't forget how happily you ate what 
I gave you on Valentine's Day...
choice_data_list: W-was it that obvious on my face?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Indeed. Enough that I'd like to 
make it for you once more.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
The smiles of the devoted are what truly 
fulfill a saint's soul. Your happiness is 
my happiness...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"So please—stay just as you are. Stay by 
my side with that same heart."
